messages.subject: [Rnomads-user] error in rNOMADS package
messages.body_plain:
Hi Team,

Thanks for providing the rNOMADS package. We are trying out the 'rNOMADS' package help file code and getting the following error:

> model.list <- NOMADSRealTimeList("dods")
Error in if (grepl("grib filter", grib.filter.tmp)) { :
  argument is of length zero

This code was working for us about two weeks ago. Is this a known error, can you suggest ways to fix this?

Thanks so much in advance, and we appreciate your time looking into this.


Regards,
Hemanth

messages.body_plain:

The NOMADS website was changed and that made some rNOMADS functions
stop working.  Please use the attached update for now until I have a
chance to put it on CRAN.  Let me know if this solves the problem.

Best,

Danny
